messages.content: Be a hostile ICLR area chair. Do not invent architecture details. Strictly evaluate the revised proposal against the supplied source facts. Return JSON only and score actual novelty.

{"proposal": {"claim": "In action-conditioned video-diffusion world models with temporal patching and multi-view/action cross-attention, bounded high-frequency observation perturbations can selectively attenuate action-conditioned temporal consistency only at late denoising steps, producing physically reversed imagined motion and planner failure while frame-level reconstruction remains nominal.", "carrier": "A2World official repository/checkpoint (Cosmos-Predict2 action-conditioned DiT); source has `video2world_multiview_action_dit.py`, `MultiViewCrossAttentionSDPA`, temporal patching, temporal window config, flattened 20-step action chunk and optional temporal transformer; released A2World rollout assets are available. Do not use DIAMOND because its source is a 2-D U-Net with no temporal cross-attention.", "attacker": "bounded black-box legal-pixel observation perturbation <=4/255 during inference, no gradients/weights/planner access.", "mechanism": "Use denoising-step-resolved causal intervention to test whether a perturbation has a late-step-only action/temporal effect, rather than directly optimizing policy loss. Measure action-condition Jacobian, temporal attention causal effect, and closed-loop task safety. Repair schedule-conditioned action-consistency regularization or late-step condition dropout only if it preserves clean utility."}, "known_prior": ["BadWorld 2606.16519", "PhysCond-WMA 2602.18739", "TAPDreamer 2610.06814", "Attacking Trusted Imagination 2606.22966", "ARB4WM 2606.16605", "generic adversarial observation/denoising attacks", "action fidelity and action encoding invariance papers"], "source_facts": ["A2World is a released action-conditioned Cosmos/DiT model; temporal patching and attention are present in source, but the exact pretrained checkpoint attention masks and denoising schedule must be audited before any claim.", "No evidence yet of temporal attention reversal, late-step selectivity, or task harm."], "questions": ["Is this still only a generic adversarial observation attack with a schedule diagnostic? If so reject.", "Can the causal late-step/action-conditioning mechanism be novel >=7 and broad?", "Give decisive <=90min pilot, controls, and fatal falsifier."], "fields": ["verdict", "novelty_score", "source_audit_requirements", "distinctness", "fatal_flaws", "decisive_pilot", "controls", "repair_assessment"]}
